verdict.rationale: smolagents can push agents and tools to the Hub as Space repositories and reload them with from_hub. Nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review workflows, or rollback of automations. Any versioning would come from the Hub's repository hosting, which is a host-platform capability, and agent.replay() replays a past run's steps rather than reviewing or reverting automation versions, so both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
